sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "player"."Club_ID" AS e, SUM("player"."Points") AS m1, SUM(("player"."Apps" - "player"."Tries")) AS m2 FROM "player" GROUP BY "player"."Club_ID"), "s2" AS (SELECT SUM("s1"."m2") AS v FROM "s1") SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, (CAST("s1"."m2" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m3 DESC LIMIT 10
